name: Kaapi Thrift
tagline: Pre-loved shirts, tees and overshirts from Bengaluru
story: Kaapi Thrift began as a weekend rack outside a Malleshwaram filter-coffee counter, sold one DM at a time. Every shirt is washed, pressed and tagged 1 of 1 before it goes live.

name: Stonewash Society
story: Stonewash Society hunts vintage denim and baggy cargos across Bengaluru's flea markets and mill-outlet bins. Each pair is measured, mended where it needs it and shot on a real body.

name: Kerbside Kicks
story: Kerbside Kicks rescues sneakers and loafers with plenty of miles left in them. Every pair is deep-cleaned, deodorised and re-laced before it ships.

name: Lids & Lenses
story: Lids & Lenses started with a shoebox of vintage frames from a closing optician on Commercial Street. Today it pairs them with washed caps, beanies and bucket hats, one piece at a time.

name: Second Hand
story: Second Hand restores vintage watches and chains that have already lived one life. Each piece is serviced, polished and sold with its story.
